findings.title_en: Use of unsecured ladder while carrying bulky load to roof level
Worker without safety helmet below overhead work
Worker at elevated roof edge with no visible edge protection

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: 2 high severity and 1 medium severity. The most urgent is ascent on an unsecured ladder while carrying a bulky roll. Work in the ladder and roof area should stop until access is secured and helmets and edge protection are provided.
